title: Derived isomorphism classes in fixed slice coordinates
statement: Let X be any scheme, B any commutative ring in its universe, R a commutative ring sheaf on X_proet, psi:constant(B)->R an isomorphism and W an X-etale chart. Two R-derived objects have isomorphic actual restrictions to the ringed slice at W [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction] if and only if their images under the exact fixed-coordinate chart restriction [def-weil-pbc-finite-coefficient-slice-restriction] are isomorphic. In addition this restriction of scalar extension of every constant derived B-complex is the constant complex on W.left of its universe lift [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-etale-level-data]. No boundedness, finiteness, local models or existence of etale origin is asserted.

proof.text: On the slice compose the locally bijective constant-section map with psi. Restriction along it is fully faithful. For essential surjectivity, express a fixed-module sheaf as a module presheaf over the constant ring and sheafify along this map. Its unit is invertible because the underlying additive presheaf already is a sheaf.

Compose this exact equivalence with the concrete weakly etale slice equivalence. Its composite with module-slice restriction is the fixed-coordinate functor, with identity comparisons on sections and maps. Passing to derived categories and using the factors isomorphism identifies representative-based restriction. Map isomorphisms forward and use preimageIso for the converse.
The constant-complex clause is the derived scalar-cancellation and constant-sheafification comparison.

theorem finiteCoefficient_slice_derived_coordinates
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (B : Type t) [CommRing B]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (ψ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hψ : IsIso ψ) (W : X.Etale) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R
    let H := finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction X B R ψ W
    (∀ K J : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} R₀),
      Nonempty (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses R₀ ((toProEt X).obj W) K ≅
        ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses R₀ ((toProEt X).obj W) J) ↔
      Nonempty (H.mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅ H.mapDerivedCategory.obj J)) ∧
    ∀ F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} B), Nonempty
      (H.mapDerivedCategory.obj ((completedAdicDerivedChange X ψ).obj
        ((finitePerfectAdicDerivedConstant X B).obj F)) ≅
      (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology W.left)
        (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((finitePerfectAdicAlgebraLift B).obj F))
